description:
GcStats is returned by Heap::collect and stored in Heap.last_gc_stats, read by one unit test; no telemetry event records a collection. fz-a9y.12 measured root_heap_edges with a temporary stderr print because of this. Every later ticket in this epic changes collection anatomy and must be measured on landing, so the event comes first.

Done when:
- Process::collect emits one fz.runtime.gc event (jsonl path ["fz","runtime","gc"], beside process_exited in src/telemetry/jsonl.rs) with: pid; the boundary that asked (yield, park, exit, or a caller's explicit collect); copied_bytes; live_bytes; blocks released and blocks after; the count of from-space ranges the membership test walked. Field names follow the GcStats names already documented in runtime-telemetry.md.
- Heap.last_gc_stats and its test are deleted; the GcStats return value stays for the heap's unit tests.
- One existing send fixture (00901) gains a runtime test that reads the event stream and pins the number of collections and the bytes they copied on the parent's heap on interp, run and build; the pinned values are recorded in the commit with the explanation of each.
- Documentation in the same commit: every .agent/docs page, guide (guides/*.html), README.md section and fixture README that describes a mechanism this ticket changes or removes is rewritten to the present fact in the same commit, and a grep for the old names and phrases over .agent, guides, README.md and fixtures returns nothing. Full gate green (--workspace --all-targets plus doc tests, fixture matrix with --test-threads=1). Commit in Why / What changed / Verification form. No co-author trailer, no attribution line.
title: A collection is an event: fz.runtime.gc is emitted from Process::collect
